## Fixes

- Cross-chain KDA transfers finish on their own again. A transfer that stopped halfway can be finished from History, and one the network already completed no longer shows as failed.
- Changing your account password no longer removes your recovery phrase from Export Recovery Phrase. If an earlier version already removed it, the app now says the phrase isn't available instead of showing an empty screen.
- Forms stay visible when the keyboard opens, including Import Wallet and Verify Recovery Phrase.
- Android: the app no longer crashes when you return to it after Android closed it in the background.

## Changes

- Android: the app targets Android 16 (API 36). On tablets and foldables it stays in portrait.
- The Menu has a new entry for CumulusVPN, a decentralized VPN on Flux.
- Menu descriptions wrap instead of running off the screen.

## Downloads

`eckoWALLET-v1.21.0.apk` is the signed APK for sideloading and `eckoWALLET-v1.21.0.aab` is the Play Store bundle. Compare them with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. The iOS version ships through the App Store.
